role.zh: Black Forest Labs 联合创始人兼 CEO

why.en: First author of Stable Diffusion and the latent diffusion paper — the direct source of the open image-generation wave. FLUX keeps him at the front of it.
why.zh: Stable Diffusion 与潜在扩散模型论文的第一作者，图像生成开源浪潮的直接源头。FLUX 系列使他继续领跑。

title.en: High-resolution image synthesis with latent diffusion models
title.zh: 基于潜在扩散模型的高分辨率图像合成

note.en: The Stable Diffusion paper — the direct source of the open image-generation wave.
note.zh: 即 Stable Diffusion 论文 —— 图像生成开源浪潮的直接源头。

title.en: FLUX.2
title.zh: FLUX.2

note.en: High-resolution photorealism, character and style consistency, multi-reference editing.
note.zh: 高分辨率写实、角色与风格一致性、多参考图编辑。

title.en: Wie entwickelt man KI, die die Welt wirklich versteht, Robin Rombach?
title.zh: Wie entwickelt man KI, die die Welt wirklich versteht, Robin Rombach?

note.en: Handelsblatt Disrupt interview in which Rombach discusses visual intelligence for robot perception, Black Forest Labs' dealings with Elon Musk, and competing with Google.
note.zh: 《商报》Disrupt 播客访谈：Rombach 谈机器人感知所需的视觉智能、Black Forest Labs 与马斯克的接触，以及与谷歌的竞争。

title.en: Robin Rombach über Robotergehirne, verhandeln mit Musk und Frust über die deutsche Selbstaufgabe
title.zh: Robin Rombach über Robotergehirne, verhandeln mit Musk und Frust über die deutsche Selbstaufgabe

note.en: Rombach appears as a guest on the Handelsblatt Disrupt podcast, giving a rare look inside Black Forest Labs and discussing robotics, negotiating with Musk, and Germany's competitiveness.
note.zh: Rombach作为嘉宾做客Handelsblatt Disrupt播客，罕见地分享了Black Forest Labs的内部情况，并谈及机器人、与马斯克的谈判以及德国的竞争力问题。

title.en: Self-Supervised Flow Matching for Scalable Multi-Modal Synthesis
title.zh: Self-Supervised Flow Matching for Scalable Multi-Modal Synthesis

note.en: Black Forest Labs paper showing that flow-matching models can learn strong semantic representations on their own, removing the dependence on separately trained external encoders.
note.zh: Black Forest Labs 的论文：流匹配模型可自监督地学得强语义表征，从而摆脱对单独训练的外部编码器的依赖。

title.en: Drug-like antibodies with low immunogenicity in human panels designed with Latent-X2
title.zh: Drug-like antibodies with low immunogenicity in human panels designed with Latent-X2

note.en: Latent-X2 designs drug-like antibodies that show low immunogenicity in human panels; Rombach is credited as an author and advisor to Latent Labs.
note.zh: Latent-X2 设计出在人体样本中免疫原性较低的类药抗体；Rombach 以作者兼 Latent Labs 顾问身份署名。

title.en: Latent-X: An Atom-level Frontier Model for De Novo Protein Binder Design
title.zh: Latent-X: An Atom-level Frontier Model for De Novo Protein Binder Design

note.en: Latent-X, an atom-level generative model for de novo protein binder design that skips large-scale screening; Rombach is credited as an author and advisor to Latent Labs.
note.zh: Latent-X 是用于从头设计蛋白结合体的原子级生成模型，可省去大规模筛选；Rombach 以作者兼 Latent Labs 顾问身份署名。

title.en: FLUX.1 Kontext: Flow Matching for In-Context Image Generation and Editing in Latent Space
title.zh: FLUX.1 Kontext: Flow Matching for In-Context Image Generation and Editing in Latent Space

note.en: FLUX.1 Kontext, Black Forest Labs' flow-matching model that unifies image generation and in-context editing — the flagship release of the company he leads.
note.zh: FLUX.1 Kontext 是 Black Forest Labs 将图像生成与上下文编辑统一起来的流匹配模型，也是他所领导公司的旗舰发布。

title.en: Fast High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Adversarial Diffusion Distillation
title.zh: Fast High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Adversarial Diffusion Distillation

note.en: Paper on fast high-resolution image synthesis via latent adversarial diffusion distillation (SDXL Turbo).
note.zh: 论文介绍通过潜空间对抗扩散蒸馏实现快速高分辨率图像生成（SDXL Turbo）。

title.en: Adversarial Diffusion Distillation
title.zh: Adversarial Diffusion Distillation

note.en: Adversarial Diffusion Distillation paper, the technique behind SDXL Turbo's few-step image generation.
note.zh: 《对抗扩散蒸馏》论文，即SDXL Turbo少步数图像生成技术背后的方法。

title.en: SV3D: Novel Multi-view Synthesis and 3D Generation from a Single Image Using Latent Video Diffusion
title.zh: SV3D: Novel Multi-view Synthesis and 3D Generation from a Single Image Using Latent Video Diffusion

note.en: SV3D paper on novel multi-view synthesis and 3D generation from a single image using latent video diffusion.
note.zh: 《SV3D》论文，利用潜在视频扩散从单张图像实现新视角合成与3D生成。

title.en: The Researcher to Founder Journey, and the Power of Open Models
title.zh: The Researcher to Founder Journey, and the Power of Open Models

note.en: Rombach and his Black Forest Labs co-founders discuss their path from researchers to founders and the case for open models.
note.zh: Rombach与Black Forest Labs联合创始人们探讨了从研究者到创业者的转型历程，以及开放模型的价值。

title.en: Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
title.zh: Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers for High-Resolution Image Synthesis

note.en: The Stable Diffusion 3 paper: scaling rectified flow transformers for high-resolution text-to-image synthesis.
note.zh: Stable Diffusion 3 论文：将修正流 Transformer 扩展到高分辨率文生图合成。

title.en: aMUSEd: An Open MUSE Reproduction
title.zh: aMUSEd: An Open MUSE Reproduction

note.en: aMUSEd, an open lightweight masked image model reproducing MUSE at a tenth of the parameters for fast text-to-image generation.
note.zh: aMUSEd 是对 MUSE 的开源轻量复现，参数量仅十分之一，用于快速文生图。

title.en: Text to Video: The Next Leap in AI Generation
title.zh: Text to Video: The Next Leap in AI Generation

note.en: Rombach discusses Stable Video Diffusion and the leap to text-to-video AI generation.
note.zh: Rombach探讨了Stable Video Diffusion以及文本生成视频这一AI生成技术的新飞跃。

title.en: DiffusionSat: A Generative Foundation Model for Satellite Imagery
title.zh: DiffusionSat: A Generative Foundation Model for Satellite Imagery

note.en: DiffusionSat adapts diffusion generative modelling to satellite imagery, a Stanford collaboration he co-authored.
note.zh: DiffusionSat 将扩散生成模型迁移到卫星遥感影像，他是这项斯坦福合作研究的共同作者。

title.en: Stable Video Diffusion: Scaling Latent Video Diffusion Models to Large Datasets
title.zh: Stable Video Diffusion: Scaling Latent Video Diffusion Models to Large Datasets

note.en: Stable Video Diffusion: scaling latent video diffusion and its data curation to state-of-the-art text- and image-to-video generation.
note.zh: Stable Video Diffusion：扩展潜空间视频扩散模型与数据整理流程，做到当时领先的文生视频与图生视频效果。

title.en: SDXL: Improving Latent Diffusion Models for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
title.zh: SDXL: Improving Latent Diffusion Models for High-Resolution Image Synthesis

note.en: SDXL, the larger-backbone latent diffusion model that became the widely used open text-to-image baseline.
note.zh: SDXL 采用更大骨干网络的潜空间扩散模型，成为被广泛使用的开源文生图基线。

title.en: NeuralField-LDM: Scene Generation with Hierarchical Latent Diffusion Models
title.zh: NeuralField-LDM: Scene Generation with Hierarchical Latent Diffusion Models

note.en: NeuralField-LDM generates 3D scenes with hierarchical latent diffusion, extending latent diffusion beyond flat images.
note.zh: NeuralField-LDM 用分层潜空间扩散生成三维场景，把潜空间扩散从二维图像推向三维。

title.en: Align your Latents: High-Resolution Video Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
title.zh: Align your Latents: High-Resolution Video Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models

note.en: Video LDM: turning image latent diffusion models into high-resolution video generators by learning temporal layers.
note.zh: Video LDM：通过训练时间维度的网络层，把图像潜空间扩散模型变成高分辨率视频生成器。

title.en: On Distillation of Guided Diffusion Models
title.zh: On Distillation of Guided Diffusion Models

note.en: Distillation of classifier-free guided diffusion models into far fewer sampling steps, an early step toward fast diffusion inference.
note.zh: 将无分类器引导的扩散模型蒸馏到远少的采样步数，是扩散快速推理的早期工作。

title.en: Text-Guided Synthesis of Artistic Images with Retrieval-Augmented Diffusion Models
title.zh: Text-Guided Synthesis of Artistic Images with Retrieval-Augmented Diffusion Models

note.en: Retrieval-augmented diffusion models for text-guided artistic image synthesis, conditioning generation on retrieved examples.
note.zh: 用检索增强的扩散模型做文本引导的艺术图像合成，以检索到的样例作为生成条件。

title.en: Semi-Parametric Neural Image Synthesis
title.zh: Semi-Parametric Neural Image Synthesis

note.en: Semi-parametric image synthesis: pairing a generative model with an external image database so capability scales without growing the network.
note.zh: 半参数化图像合成：让生成模型搭配外部图像数据库，不扩大网络也能提升能力。

title.en: ImageBART: Bidirectional Context with Multinomial Diffusion for Autoregressive Image Synthesis
title.zh: ImageBART: Bidirectional Context with Multinomial Diffusion for Autoregressive Image Synthesis

note.en: ImageBART combines autoregressive image synthesis with multinomial diffusion to give the model bidirectional context.
note.zh: ImageBART 将自回归图像合成与多项式扩散结合，为模型引入双向上下文。

title.en: High-Resolution Complex Scene Synthesis with Transformers
title.zh: High-Resolution Complex Scene Synthesis with Transformers

note.en: Transformer-based synthesis of complex high-resolution scenes from coarse layouts.
note.zh: 基于 Transformer，从粗粒度布局合成复杂的高分辨率场景图像。

title.en: Stochastic Image-to-Video Synthesis using cINNs
title.zh: Stochastic Image-to-Video Synthesis using cINNs

note.en: Stochastic image-to-video synthesis with conditional invertible neural networks, predicting plausible futures from a single frame.
note.zh: 用条件可逆神经网络做随机的图生视频合成，从单帧预测多种合理的后续运动。

title.en: Geometry-Free View Synthesis: Transformers and no 3D Priors
title.zh: Geometry-Free View Synthesis: Transformers and no 3D Priors

note.en: Geometry-free novel view synthesis, showing transformers can generate new views without explicit 3D priors.
note.zh: 无几何先验的新视角合成，证明 Transformer 无需显式三维先验也能生成新视角。

title.en: Taming Transformers for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
title.zh: Taming Transformers for High-Resolution Image Synthesis

note.en: Taming Transformers (VQGAN), the discrete latent representation that made high-resolution transformer image synthesis practical and fed directly into latent diffusion.
note.zh: Taming Transformers（VQGAN）提出的离散潜表示，使高分辨率 Transformer 图像合成可行，并直接为潜空间扩散奠定基础。

title.en: A Note on Data Biases in Generative Models
title.zh: A Note on Data Biases in Generative Models

note.en: A short note on how dataset biases propagate into generative models and how they surface in the samples.
note.zh: 一篇简短论文，讨论数据集偏差如何传导进生成模型，并在生成样本中显现。

title.en: Making Sense of CNNs: Interpreting Deep Representations & Their Invariances with INNs
title.zh: Making Sense of CNNs: Interpreting Deep Representations & Their Invariances with INNs

note.en: Interpreting what CNN representations encode and which invariances they discard, using invertible neural networks.
note.zh: 借助可逆神经网络解释 CNN 表征编码了什么信息、又丢弃了哪些不变性。

title.en: $300M Series B at a $3.25B post-money valuation
title.zh: 3 亿美元 B 轮，投后估值 32.5 亿美元

body.en: Co-led by Salesforce Ventures and Anjney Midha (a16z), with NVIDIA, General Catalyst and Temasek. Total raised ~$450M. FLUX.2 announced 25 November 2025.
body.zh: Salesforce Ventures 与 a16z 的 Anjney Midha 联合领投，NVIDIA、General Catalyst、淡马锡参与。累计融资约 4.5 亿美元。FLUX.2 于 2025-11-25 发布。

title.en: Multi-year $140M contract with Meta
title.zh: 与 Meta 签署 1.4 亿美元多年合约

body.en: Total contract value across Meta, Adobe, Canva and Snap reached roughly $300M.
body.zh: Meta、Adobe、Canva 与 Snap 的合约总值约 3 亿美元。
